resume: Felucca 1.5 extended to six tracks, with new engines (SID, all 48 Braids models, TB-303, engines inspired by Analog Four, SY Chip and Digitone 2), a ping-pong delay and a new reverb. 64-step sequencer, stochastic and Euclidean modes.

commandes.role: Octave down. In actions and dialogs, goes back.
Octave up. In actions and dialogs, confirms. On SEQ, STEP page, held 0.4 s: the step settings sheet.
Effects pages; held: FX layer (repeat, reverse, sweeps, tape stop, freeze, harmonizer, flanger, phaser).
Printed SCL in the docs. Scale and chord pages; held: SCL layer.
LFO, LFO 2, LFO DEST, MOD pages. Held with a knob: momentary change.
Sound edit pages (EDIT 1, EDIT 2, VOICE...). Held: EDIT layer (the engines).
SONG page; held: GLO layer (mutes, solos, levels, tap tempo).
HOME, MIXER, CLOCK; held: the menu.
USER, PRESETS, PHRASES, PROJECT, TOOLS pages; held: undo (UNDO).
STEP (piano roll or drum grid) and AUTOMATION pages; held: SEQ tools (CLEAR, REVERSE, SHIFT, RANDOM, COOK).
Arms the track; held: REC layer (CLEAR, CLICK, COUNT-IN).
Changes the sound, on pages that are not lists.
Picks the track, on all pages.
They play the track; on SEQ, they are the steps.

gestes: A layer button tapped twice: keeps the layer open.
SEQ, STOCH page: the STOCH or EUCLID mode makes the track play by random draw or by Euclidean rhythm.
